title: GenerationTrace
description: The per-block record of what produced a generated document and why. Produced by the core, read by the lawyer review screen and by the client-facing anatomy view, and archived unchanged in the issued document's passport.

trace_version.description: The shape of this document. Incremented when a field is added or removed, so a trace archived years ago can still be read.

service_id.description: The service this document was generated for.

law_refs.description: Every norm any block in this trace cites, listed once. A block cites entries here by `norm_id`.

blocks.description: One entry per block that entered the document, in document order.

BlockTrust.description: Who wrote the text of a block. `template` is deterministic fill-in of lawyer-authored text, `ai_generated` was produced by the model, `lawyer_edited` was produced by the model and then corrected by a human.

LawSource.description: The publisher a norm was read from.

ToolOutcome.description: Whether a tool call returned a result or failed.

Instant.description: An instant in UTC, ISO 8601 with a `Z` suffix and no offset. Seconds are required; milliseconds are optional.

LawRef.description: A norm the document rests on, as it stood when the document was generated. Both a pointer into the register and a snapshot of it: the pointer is what a live screen follows, and the snapshot is what remains readable after the register row has moved on.

norm_id.description: The watched norm this cites, in the platform's register.

act_id.description: The act as its publisher names it, normalized: `2947-14`, `z0123-19`.

act_title.description: The act's title, for a person to read. The identifier is not one.

article.description: The article within the act, or null when the whole act is what is relied on.

relied_on.description: One line on what the service leans on this norm for, written by the lawyer who attached it. This is what tells a later reader whether a change to the norm matters.

verified_at.description: When this norm was last checked against its published text and found unchanged, as of generation time. Null when it had never been successfully verified.

BlockCondition.description: The branching condition that selected a block, as the core evaluated it.

expression.description: The condition as the template states it, rendered for a person to read.

field_keys.description: Field keys of the answers the condition read. Keys only, never values.

ToolCall.description: One call the core made while producing a block. Names what ran and how it ended; carries no arguments and no results.

tool.description: The tool's name, as the core registers it.

TraceBlock.description: One block of the generated document, and the account of what produced it.

id.description: Stable across regenerations, so a re-run updates the trace rather than scrambling it.

title.description: The block's heading, as the template names it.

needs_attention.description: The core is not confident in this block and a human should read it.

selected_by.description: The condition that put this block in the document, or null when the block is unconditional.

law_ref_ids.description: The norms this block implements, as `norm_id` values resolving against the trace's `law_refs`.

questionnaire_fields.description: Field keys of the client answers that fed this block. Keys only, never values.

tool_calls.description: The core's calls while producing this block, in the order they started.
